tools.name: get_v2
tools.description: Google Images results for a query, twenty a page: for each image its URL, width and height, its thumbnail with width and height, and the page it is on. `response.next_cursor` fetches the next twenty (null after the last page). Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_v1
tools.description: Images labelled for reuse (Creative Commons, public domain), up to `max` (default 10, at most 200), under `response.images`: title, type, the image with its width and height, thumbnails, the page it is on and a cached copy. Search Images searches all images. Billing per call: 1 Credits.
